title: Optimal Delegation in a Multidimensional World
abstract: arXiv:2208.11835v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study a model of delegation in which a principal takes a multidimensional action and an agent has private information about a multidimensional state. We provide necessary and sufficient conditions for an arbitrary mechanism to maximize the principal's expected payoff. A key step shows that a function is the indirect utility of an incentive-compatible mechanism if and only if it is convex and lies below the agent's full-discretion payoff. We apply our optimality conditions to convex delegation sets and characterize when a single budget optimally links decisions. Linking can preserve discretion even when separate delegation would eliminate it. Optimal linking can also require a nonconvex delegation set, even with uniformly distributed types. If the principal cares little about aligned decisions, every optimal mechanism randomizes: risk in an aligned decision provides incentives in the biased ones at little cost to her.

translated_title: 多维世界中的最优授权
translated_abstract: 我们研究了一个授权模型，其中委托人采取多维行动，而代理人拥有关于多维状态的私人信息。我们为任意机制最大化委托人期望收益提供了充要条件。关键一步表明，一个函数是激励相容机制的间接效用，当且仅当它是凸的且位于代理人的完全自由裁量收益之下。我们将这些最优性条件应用于凸授权集，并刻画了单一预算何时能最优地联结决策。即使分开授权会消除自由裁量权，联结决策仍可以保留它。最优联结也可能需要非凸的授权集，即使类型服从均匀分布。如果委托人对一致决策的关心程度较低，那么每个最优机制都会随机化：一致决策中的风险能在有偏决策中提供激励，而给委托人带来的成本很小。
tldr: 本文研究多维授权问题，给出了任意机制最优的充要条件，并证明单一预算联结决策可以保留自由裁量权、可能需要非凸授权集，且当委托人不太在意一致决策时所有最优机制都必须随机化。
en_tdlr: This paper provides necessary and sufficient conditions for optimal mechanisms in multidimensional delegation, showing that linking decisions via a single budget can preserve discretion, may require nonconvex delegation sets, and that every optimal mechanism must randomize when the principal cares little about aligned decisions.
